title: The website editor keeps its own drifted copy of the colour tokens

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: components/sites/editor/editor.css:9-19 (imported unconditionally by shell.tsx:33, 114 baselined literals) holds --text-strong:#34312E vs --fq-ink #1E1B18, --bg-canvas:#FAF4EA vs #FBF7F0 and two more drifted values; .we-canvas-root rules still apply inside the Frequency canvas. THE FIX: read the shared tokens instead of local literals.
